articles.summary: A Simple Idea. Leading to Great Changes 70% of profits from Give Me Tap are used to fund independent water projects in regions where it’s needed most, including Namibia. The concept of GiveMeTap was dreamt up by Edwin-Broni-Mensahin 2010 and it has since won him an award as "most outstanding black graduate in Britain 2
articles.title: GiveMeTap - Making our world a fountain
